steps.title: Prepare laminin coating solution
steps.instruction: Aliquot 20 µL of 2 mg/mL laminin stock into 2 mL tubes, freeze at –20 °C; on coating day thaw, add PBS to a final concentration of 20 µg/mL (total 2 mL), vortex, pipette 170 µL onto each well of an 8‑well chambered coverslip or a #1.5 coverglass‑bottom 35 mm dish, incubate 15–20 min at 37 °C, aspirate leaving a thin film, then seed cells in DMEM + 10 % FBS to reach 50–60 % confluency.

steps.title: Prepare PEM buffer (pH 6.95)
steps.instruction: Dissolve 15.11 g PIPES, 0.95 g EGTA, and 0.20 g MgCl₂·6H₂O in deionized water, adjust volume to 500 mL, filter 0.2 µm, store at 4 °C in the dark (use within 6 months).

steps.title: Prepare fixation‑staining solution
steps.instruction: On ice keep 500 µL 16 % PFA (to give 4 % final), 16 µL 10 % Triton X‑100 (0.08 % final), 1 µL 5 mM TMR‑HaloLigand (2.5 µM final), 2 µL DAPI (1:1000 dilution), and 1 481 µL PEM buffer; total volume 2 mL, keep on ice and in the dark.

steps.title: Prepare 1 % BSA blocking solution
steps.instruction: Dissolve 0.05 g BSA in 5 mL PBS, filter 0.2 µm, store at 4 °C for up to 2 weeks.

steps.title: Prepare 10× AB buffer (pH 7.5)
steps.instruction: Dissolve 0.37 g KCl, 0.34 g imidazole, 0.16 g MgCl₂·6H₂O, 0.30 g EGTA in deionized water, add 20 µL 1 M DTT, bring volume to 20 mL, filter, aliquot 1 mL, store at –20 °C.

steps.title: Prepare 50× GOC oxygen‑scavenger
steps.instruction: Mix 720 µL catalase (7.2 mg/mL) with 200 µL 10× AB buffer and 80 µL H₂O (1 mL total); mix 1 mL glucose oxidase (43.2 mg/mL) with 200 µL 10× AB buffer and 800 µL H₂O (1 mL total). Spin each at 95 000 × g for 15 min at 4 °C, keep supernatant, combine equal volumes of the two supernatants, add 2 mL glycerol (50 % v/v) to reach 4 mL total, aliquot 100 µL, store at –20 °C (discard if frozen solid).

steps.title: Prepare RIPA lysis buffer
steps.instruction: Dissolve 1.5 g Tris base, 2.2 g NaCl, 2.5 mL NP‑40, 1.25 g sodium deoxycholate, 250 µL 10 % SDS in deionized water, bring volume to 250 mL, filter 0.2 µm, store at 4 °C for up to 1 week.

steps.title: Prepare semi‑dry transfer buffer
steps.instruction: Dissolve 40.7 g Tris base, 19.5 g glycine, 25.1 g tricine, 0.9 g EDTA in deionized water, bring volume to 1 L, store at room temperature.

steps.title: Prepare 5× SDS loading buffer
steps.instruction: Use commercial 5× SDS loading buffer (0.1 M DTT, 2 % SDS, 0.05 % bromophenol blue, 0.05 M Tris‑HCl, 10 % glycerol, pH 6.8).

steps.title: Equilibrate transfection reagents and media
steps.instruction: Bring FuGENE HD or Lipofectamine 2000 and Opti‑MEM to room temperature (~25 °C); warm DMEM + 10 % FBS to 37 °C.

steps.title: Check cell confluency
steps.instruction: Verify cells in one well of a 6‑well dish are 80–90 % confluent by manual inspection.

steps.title: Prepare DNA‑reagent mixtures
steps.instruction: For FuGENE HD: in a 1.5 mL tube combine 1 µg HaloTag‑Myo10‑Flag plasmid + 0.2 µg calmodulin plasmid in 200 µL Opti‑MEM, pipette 20×, add 4.2 µL FuGENE HD (3.5:1 ratio), pipette 20×, incubate 10 min at RT. For Lipofectamine 2000: in a tube combine 2.5 µg HaloTag plasmid + 0.2 µg calmodulin plasmid in 250 µL Opti‑MEM, pipette 20×; in a second tube add 6.75 µL Lipofectamine 2000 to 250 µL Opti‑MEM, pipette 20×, combine with DNA tube, pipette 20×, incubate 20 min at RT.

steps.title: Replace medium and add transfection mix
steps.instruction: Replace well medium with 2 mL DMEM + 10 % FBS warmed to 34–37 °C; add 200 µL FuGENE/DNA mixture or 500 µL Lipofectamine/DNA mixture drop‑wise across the surface, gently shake dish, incubate 24–48 h at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂.

steps.title: Warm reagents for seeding
steps.instruction: Warm PBS, DMEM + 10 % FBS, and Accutase to 37 °C.

steps.title: Detach transfected cells
steps.instruction: Aspirate media from the 6‑well, wash gently with 400 µL PBS, add 400 µL Accutase, incubate 15 min at 37 °C.

steps.title: Collect and spin cells
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL DMEM + 10 % FBS, transfer to a 1.5 mL tube, spin 400 × g for 3.5 min at RT.

steps.title: Resuspend and seed onto coverslips
steps.instruction: Resuspend pellet in DMEM + 10 % FBS to seed 62 000–75 000 cells per well of an 8‑well chamber (≈50–60 % confluency, ≥200 µL media) and 100 000–300 000 cells on each round coverslip; gently release cells into the corner of each well, avoid rotating the coverslip, and ensure even dispersion.

steps.title: Seed cells for SDS‑PAGE
steps.instruction: Plate the remaining cells into a well of a 6‑well dish for later SDS‑PAGE analysis; return all dishes to the incubator.

steps.title: Allow cells to attach
steps.instruction: Incubate seeded coverslips 2–3 h until cells are attached before proceeding.

steps.title: Fix and stain cells (fixed sample)
steps.instruction: Keep fixation‑staining solution on ice; quickly aspirate media from all wells of the 8‑well chamber, add 200 µL cold solution per well, cover with foil, incubate 20 min at RT in the dark; wash 3 × 250 µL PBS (4 min each); add 200 µL 1 mM Phalloidin‑AF647 in 1 % BSA, incubate 20 min at RT in the dark; wash 3 × 250 µL PBS (4 min each); proceed to imaging.

steps.title: Label and image live cells
steps.instruction: Add 200 µL DMEM + 10 % FBS containing 0.75 µM TMR‑HaloLigand to each round coverslip, incubate 15 min at 34–37 °C; wash 2 × 200 µL pre‑warmed DMEM + 10 % FBS; image in 200 µL DMEM + 10 % FBS with 1× GOC.

steps.title: Collect lysates for SDS‑PAGE (fixed cells)
steps.instruction: Warm PBS, DMEM + 10 % FBS, and Accutase to 37 °C; aspirate media from the 6‑well, wash 400 µL PBS, add 400 µL Accutase (no ligand for fixed cells), incubate 15 min at 37 °C; add 500 µL DMEM + 10 % FBS, collect cells, spin 400 × g 3.5 min RT; remove supernatant, keep pellet on ice or store at –80 °C (process within 1 yr).

steps.title: Prepare lysates for SDS‑PAGE
steps.instruction: Thaw RIPA buffer, add 1 mM PMSF and protease inhibitor cocktail; calculate volume so that 5 µL suspension contains 50 000 cells, add cold RIPA to pellet, pipette 20×, incubate on ice 15 min; spin 15 000 × g 10 min at 4 °C, transfer supernatant; for fixed‑cell lysates add 2 µM TMR‑HaloLigand to 5 µL lysate in 10 µL total, ice 10 min (skip for live‑cell lysates).

steps.title: Prepare HaloTag standard dilutions
steps.instruction: Dilute HaloTag standard protein 1:500 in PBS with 0.5 µM TMR‑HaloLigand; aliquot 1.25, 2.5, 5, 10, and 15 ng into 10 µL PBS per LoBind tube.

steps.title: Add loading buffer and heat samples
steps.instruction: Add 2.5 µL 5× SDS loading buffer to each lysate and standard sample, heat 70 °C for 10 min.

steps.title: Run SDS‑PAGE and image gel
steps.instruction: Load 12.5 µL of each sample onto a 4 %–20 % Mini‑PROTEAN TGX stain‑free gel, run 180 V for 45 min; image gel on ChemiDoc in stain‑free, AF647 (695/55 filter), and rhodamine (605/50 filter) channels.

steps.title: Analyze gel bands with ImageJ
steps.instruction: Open gel image in ImageJ, use Gel Analysis plugin: select first lane (Analyze → Gels → Select First Lane), then subsequent lanes (Select Next Lane); generate lane profiles (Plot Lanes), draw baselines with straight‑line tool, use wand tool to measure area under each peak.

steps.title: Generate standard curve and calculate molecules
steps.instruction: Import integrated band intensities into the provided R script (SignaltoMolecules.Rmd), perform linear regression on HaloTag standard curve, apply the slope (y = 24.32 x) to cell‑lysate signals, adjust by microscopy‑derived transfection efficiency and 90 % labeling efficiency to obtain Myo10 molecules per cell.

steps.title: Perform Myo10 western blot
steps.instruction: Mix 5 µL lysate (50 000 cells) +5 µL PBS +2.5 µL 5× loading buffer, heat 70 °C 10 min, load 12.5 µL onto a 4 %–20 % TGX gel, run 180 V 45 min, image stain‑free and AF647 channels; soak filter papers in 1× semi‑dry transfer buffer, activate PVDF in methanol, assemble sandwich (filter‑membrane‑gel‑filter), remove bubbles, add 2–3 mL buffer, run 1.3 A constant current, 25 V for 12 min; block membrane 5 % milk in 1× TBST 1 h RT shaking 60 rpm; incubate primary antibodies (anti‑Myo10 and anti‑β‑tubulin, 10 000× dilution) in 5 % milk 1× TBST overnight 4 °C or 1 h RT shaking 60 rpm; wash 3 × 10 min with 5 % milk or 1× TBST shaking 60 rpm; incubate secondary antibodies (rabbit‑HRP, mouse‑HRP, 10 000×) in 1× TBST 1 h RT shaking 60 rpm; wash 3 × 10 min with 1× TBST shaking 60 rpm; mix 1 mL SuperSignal West Femto peroxide with 1 mL luminol/enhancer, incubate blot 2 min in a Ziploc, image on ChemiDoc Hi‑Resolution.

steps.title: Verify TMR‑HaloLigand labeling efficiency
steps.instruction: Dilute HaloTag standard to 8 µM in 20 µL PBS, add TMR‑HaloLigand to 40 µM (5× excess) (prepare 500 µM TMR by mixing 1 µL 5 mM TMR with 9 µL DMSO); incubate on ice 10 min; measure A₂₈₀ on NanoDrop (Protein A280, 1 Abs = 1 mg/mL); fill a LoBind tube with ~10 µL Bio‑Beads SM‑2, wash 3 × 400 µL methanol, 3 × water, 3 × PBS (vortex 3 s each); add 20 µL labeled protein, incubate 2 h RT dark; spin 600 × g 3 min RT, collect supernatant; measure protein A₂₈₀ and absorbance at 533 nm; combine 10 µL supernatant with 2.5 µL 5× loading buffer, heat 70 °C 10 min, load 12.5 µL onto TGX gel, run 180 V 45 min, image stain‑free and rhodamine channels, analyze band intensity with ImageJ to determine labeling percentage.

steps.title: Determine TMR‑HaloLigand saturation
steps.instruction: Prepare a 20 µM TMR‑HaloLigand stock in DMSO; make working solutions at 0.05, 0.1, 0.5, 0.75, 1, and 2.5 µM. For fixed cells: add TMR to cold fixation buffer (4 % PFA, 0.08 % Triton, 1:1000 DAPI in PEM) to reach each concentration, keep on ice; aspirate media, add 200 µL buffer per well, RT 20 min dark; wash 3 × 250 µL PBS, stain with 200 µL 1 mM Phalloidin‑AF647 in 1 % BSA 20 min RT dark, wash, image. For live cells: add TMR‑HaloLigand to pre‑warmed DMEM + 10 % FBS to reach each concentration (200 µL per coverslip), incubate dark 34–37 °C, wash 2 × 200 µL DMEM + 10 % FBS, image in DMEM + 10 % FBS with 1× GOC. Identify saturation at 0.5 µM (≈90 % labeling).

steps.title: Image fixed and live cells
steps.instruction: Use an Axiovert microscope with a ≥60× water objective (NA > 1.2). For live imaging, heat objective to 37 °C for 45 min before use. Set camera gain and exposure so pixel values use the full dynamic range but stay below saturation. For fixed cells: acquire TMR channel (520 nm) then AF633 channel (630 nm), collect 50 images per bioreplicate (150 total). For live cells: use 300 ms exposure, record 10 random cells per session (≤6 min videos), collect 30 images across three bioreplicates (≈50 cells each). Save all stacks in Micro‑Manager. Record transfection efficiency by imaging ≥100 random cells, counting DAPI‑positive nuclei then TMR‑positive cells, and calculate the percentage.
